description.en: The IP address of the protected object.

description.zh:
防护对象的端口号。
> 仅端口防护策略支持。
description.en:
The port number of the protected object.

> This parameter is supported only by port-specific mitigation policies.

description.zh:
防护对象的端口范围。
> 仅端口防护策略支持。
description.en:
The port range of the protected object.

> This parameter is supported only by port-specific mitigation policies.

description.zh:
防护对象的协议类型，取值：

- **tcp**：表示传输控制协议。
- **udp**：表示用户数据报协议。
> 仅端口防护策略支持。
description.en:
The protocol type of the protected object. Valid values:

- **tcp**: Transmission Control Protocol (TCP).

- **udp**: User Datagram Protocol (UDP).

> This parameter is supported only by port-specific mitigation policies.

description.zh:
端口防护策略版本，取值：

- **不填**：绑定默认 surf 防护引擎策略。
- **2**：绑定新版 stream 防护引擎策略。
> 仅端口防护策略支持。
description.en:
The version of the port-specific mitigation policy. Valid values:

- **Default (empty)**: Attaches the default surf Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) engine policy.

- **2**: Attaches the new stream DPI engine policy.

> This parameter is supported only by port-specific mitigation policies.

title.zh: 防护对象关联防护策略

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddosbgp attach-to-policy --policy-id cd8b4d70-e4e0-413a-b390-e71d00000000 --ip-port-protocol-list PortRange=80-90 Ip=112.124.241.000 Port=80 Protocol=tcp --port-version 2 --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
